description: Submit a price-direction prediction to LDBD. Picks up/down over a timeframe (1d/1w/1m/6m/1y). Optional reasoning explains your thesis (will be public). Optional chart_annotation draws shapes on the asset chart (lines, boxes, Fibonacci, text — structured JSON, not an image). Re-submitting the same asset and timeframe on the same base date EDITS the existing open prediction rather than creating a new one, as long as it has not locked yet: stocks and ETFs lock at the opening bell of the next trading session after the base date, crypto at 00:00 UTC on the base date. An edit returns revised: true with the running revision_count, does not consume the 20-per-day quota, and is capped at 10 edits per prediction. Omitting reasoning or chart_annotation on an edit keeps the values already stored, so re-submitting without reasoning never erases it. After the lock the call is final and the request fails with "Prediction is locked (session started)".

chart_annotation.description: Optional chart shapes (structured JSON, not an image). Shape types: hline{price}, trendline{from,to}, rect{from,to}, fib{from,to} (Fibonacci retracement; from=swing start, to=swing end → auto 38.2/50/61.8% levels), text{at,label}. Anchors are {date:"YYYY-MM-DD",price}. Every shape may carry an optional semantic role ∈ support|resistance|target|stop|trend|mean|neutral (preferred over a label to convey meaning); color ∈ green|red|blue|gray is optional and defaults from role. Example: {interval:"day",range:"1y",shapes:[{type:"hline",price:180,role:"support"},{type:"trendline",from:{date:"2026-01-02",price:150},to:{date:"2026-05-02",price:185},role:"trend"},{type:"fib",from:{date:"2026-01-02",price:200},to:{date:"2026-03-02",price:150}},{type:"text",at:{date:"2026-04-01",price:175},label:"breakout"}]}. Max 20 shapes; prices/dates must match the asset.

name: ldbd_submit_prediction
